integrity: Analytic proof and independently executable geometric and quadrature checks included; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed convex polygon with no consecutive collinear sides and uniform perimeter sampling; no finite-sample stability, unknown-perimeter angle inversion, cyclic angle-order recovery, or reconstruction of side lengths in general. Historical priority is provisional. Numerical checks corroborate but do not prove asymptotic claims.
title: The corner law and angle tomography of perimeter loss in random inscribed polygons
